local_or_edit.description: Pro tip; Click on the clip icon for a file explorer...
local_or_edit.field.mod_or_engine_name.d: The FNF mod/engine name to display in the launcher.
local_or_edit.field.icon_path.title: Icon Path
local_or_edit.field.icon_path.descriptio: Any icon your hear desires. Make sure it's 1:1. It can be URL or Path.

local_or_edit.field.description.title: Description

local_or_edit.field.banner_url.title: Banner URL

delete_instance.title: Delete Instance
